web3.title: Web3 Feature Lab
web3.desc: A series of interactive on-chain features. Each card is a standalone experiment - just connect a browser wallet to try it.

features.notaryDesc: Connect a wallet to write up to 64 bytes into BSC Testnet event logs - hash as proof, permanently queryable and tamper-proof.
features.transferDesc: Query the BNB balance of any address on BSC Testnet, and send native token transfers with your wallet.
features.klineDesc: View ETH / 1h / last 30 days Hyperliquid candlestick chart.

web3.seoDescription: Interactive on-chain features: notary, transfer & K-line chart.
